words.meaning: able to recover quickly from difficulties
examples: She stayed resilient after losing her job.
Она не сломалась после потери работы.

words.meaning: feeling that there is too much to deal with
examples: I feel a bit overwhelmed at work this week.
На этой неделе я немного зашиваюсь на работе.
He was overwhelmed by all the kind messages.
Его ошеломили все эти добрые сообщения.
She was reluctant to speak English at first.
Сначала она не хотела говорить по-английски.
I'm reluctant to change my plans.
words.collocations: be reluctant to do sth, a reluctant hero

words.meaning: to grow, develop or be successful
examples: Растения отлично растут в этом климате.
words.collocations: thrive on challenges, a thriving business

examples: We found a cosy café near the beach.
Мы нашли уютное кафе у пляжа.
Her flat is small but cosy.
words.collocations: a cosy evening, nice and cosy (US: cozy)

words.meaning: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
examples: Sorry, this is a bit awkward…

words.meaning: wanting to do something very much
examples: The students are eager to learn.
I'm eager to hear your news!
words.collocations: eager to do sth, an eager learner

words.meaning: to delay doing something you should do
examples: Stop procrastinating and start your homework!
По понедельникам я вечно всё откладываю.

words.meaning: easy to understand or do; honest
to walk around slowly without a clear purpose
examples: We wandered around the old town.
I'm so grateful for your help.
Я так благодарна за твою помощь.
We should be grateful for small things.

words.meaning: something annoying that takes time and effort
examples: Getting a visa is such a hassle.

words.meaning: done because you suddenly want to, without planning
examples: We took a spontaneous trip to the mountains.

phrases.note: Phrasal verb — очень частый в разговоре
examples: I can't figure out this app.
Не могу разобраться в этом приложении.

phrases.note: Можно сказать и на прощание: «Take it easy!»
examples: Take it easy, it's not a big deal.
I'm taking it easy this weekend.

phrases.note: catch up with sb / catch up on sth
examples: Давай встретимся на кофе и поболтаем!
I need to catch up on sleep.
I'm getting used to the heat.
You'll get used to waking up early.
Pizza or sushi? It's up to you.
It's up to you whether you come.

phrases.note: Меняем решение прямо в разговоре (UK: on second thoughts)
examples: I'll have tea. On second thought, coffee, please.
Я буду чай. Хотя нет, кофе, пожалуйста.

phrases.phrase: I'm not a big fan of…
examples: I'm not a big fan of horror films.
It was great to meet you — let's keep in touch!
Было здорово познакомиться — давай не теряться!

phrases.note: Синоним: give it a go / give it a shot
examples: I've never surfed, but I'll give it a try.
Я никогда не серфила, но попробую.
It makes sense to book early.
You worked all night? No wonder you're tired.
Ты работал всю ночь? Неудивительно, что ты устал.
It's 7 pm — let's call it a day.
Уже 7 вечера — давайте на сегодня всё.
The test was a piece of cake!

quizzes.explain: do sb a favour — оказать услугу.

quizzes.q: I'm not used to ___ up early.

mistakes.why: agree — это глагол, ему не нужен am. Как «я соглашаюсь», а не «я есть соглашаюсь».

mistakes.right: I really like this film. / I like this film very much.
mistakes.why: very не ставится перед глаголом. Используйте really перед глаголом или very much в конце.

mistakes.right: He told me the truth. / He said the truth to me.
mistakes.why: tell + кому (told me), say + что (said that…). После say нужен to: said to me.
Возраст в английском — через be: I am 25. Have здесь калька с других языков.

mistakes.wrong: Can you explain me this rule?
mistakes.right: Can you explain this rule to me?
mistakes.why: explain sth to sb — объяснять что-то кому-то. Без to нельзя.
bored — мне скучно. boring — я скучный (как человек). То же: interested / interesting, tired / tiring.
information — неисчисляемое: никаких -s и an. Нужно «одна информация» — a piece of information.
depend on — устойчивое сочетание. Никаких from или of.

mistakes.wrong: How is it called in English?
mistakes.right: What is it called in English?
mistakes.why: В английском спрашиваем «Что это называется?» — What, а не How.
Фото в английском «берут»: take a photo / take a picture.

mistakes.wrong: I'll call you when I will arrive.
mistakes.right: I'll call you when I arrive.
mistakes.why: После when, if, as soon as, before, after будущее время передаётся через Present Simple.
It's = It is. «It is depends» — два сказуемых сразу. Достаточно depends.

mistakes.right: I listen to music every day.
mistakes.why: listen to sth — после listen всегда to. Но: I'm listening! (без объекта — без to).
После did / didn't — только первая форма глагола. Прошедшее время уже «живёт» в did.
